dnssec.title: DNSSEC Management
dnssec.description: Manage the live DNSSEC signing and key rollover lifecycle for primary authoritative zones.
dnssec.liveNotice: This page reads directly from the selected server and verifies the target zone state again before every change.
dnssec.loadFailed: The live DNSSEC configuration could not be read.
dnssec.operationFailed: The DNSSEC operation could not be completed. Refresh live state and try again.
dnssec.zonesDescription: Signing is supported only for non-built-in primary zones.
dnssec.eligible: This primary zone supports DNSSEC lifecycle operations.
dnssec.keysDescription: Inspect live KSK and ZSK state and initiate rollover for a selected key.
dnssec.parentDsWarning: Signing with defaults does not create the DS record in the parent zone. Publish the DS record separately with the parent DNS provider after signing to complete the chain of trust.
dnssec.missingParentDsWarning: The zone is signed, but the server does not report a secure parent delegation. Check the DS record and delegation chain at the parent DNS provider.

confirmations.SignWithDefaults: {{zone}} will be signed with the Windows Server default KSK and ZSK settings. Parent DS publication is a separate step.
confirmations.Resign: Record signatures in {{zone}} will be generated again. Do you want to continue?
confirmations.Unsign: DNSSEC signatures and DNSSEC records will be removed from {{zone}}. Validation can fail if the parent DS record is not also removed.
confirmations.RolloverKeys: Signing key rollover will be initiated for the selected key in {{zone}}.
confirmations.SetValidationEnabled: The server DNSSEC response validation behavior will change. Invalid or missing trust anchors can cause SERVFAIL responses.
confirmations.RetrieveRootTrustAnchor: The server will use HTTPS to retrieve or update the root anchor from its configured RootTrustAnchorsURL.
confirmations.AddDsTrustAnchor: A DS trust anchor will be added for {{trustPoint}}. Have you verified the values with the authoritative publisher?
confirmations.AddDnsKeyTrustAnchor: A DNSKEY trust anchor will be added for {{trustPoint}}. Have you verified the values with the authoritative publisher?
confirmations.RemoveTrustAnchorType: All anchors of the selected type in {{trustPoint}} will be removed. This can break DNSSEC validation.

resolver.title: Recursive resolver trust
resolver.description: Manage live DNSSEC response validation and the trust points/anchors used for validation.
resolver.validationHelp: Validates the chain of trust in signed responses; validation failures return SERVFAIL to clients.
resolver.adReplicationWarning: This server has Active Directory access. Trust anchor changes may replicate forest-wide to domain controllers with the DNS role.
resolver.pointsDescription: Resolver trust starting points and the live anchor data reported by the server.
resolver.addDescription: Copy DS or DNSKEY values only from an authoritative, verified source.
resolver.name: Trust point name

reasons.OnlyPrimaryZonesSupported: This operation is supported only for primary zones.
reasons.BuiltInZoneNotSupported: Built-in system zones are excluded from DNSSEC lifecycle management.
reasons.Unknown: This zone is not eligible for DNSSEC signing.

scavenging.updated: The aging and scavenging operation completed.
scavenging.operationFailed: The operation could not be completed. Refresh the live state and try again.
scavenging.warningDescription: Incorrect aging or scavenging settings can delete valid DNS records. Only timestamped dynamic records are eligible; validate changes on a controlled zone first.
scavenging.scheduleDescription: Configure automatic scavenging and its run interval for the server.
scavenging.zonesDescription: Aging can be enabled only on eligible primary zones. Intervals are in hours.
scavenging.notEligible: This zone is not eligible for aging management
scavenging.scavengeServersPlaceholder: One IPv4 or IPv6 address per line
scavenging.scavengeServersHelp: Leave empty to avoid restricting the zone to specific scavenging servers. Up to 16 addresses are allowed.
scavenging.manualDescription: Starts an immediate scavenging attempt on the server; only stale dynamic records that meet all eligibility rules are processed.
scavenging.manualReady: The server and at least one zone are enabled for scavenging.
scavenging.manualUnavailable: Enable server scavenging and aging on at least one eligible zone before starting.

confirmations.UpdateServer: The server's automatic scavenging schedule will be changed. Do you want to continue?
confirmations.UpdateZone: The selected zone's aging intervals will be changed. These settings affect when records become eligible for cleanup.
confirmations.StartScavenging: Scavenging will start immediately on the server. Dynamic records considered stale and eligible can be deleted. Do you want to continue?
